test_title: PYST 35: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All pulse are rice.

All rice are wheat.

All wheat are corn.

Conclusions:

(1) All pulse are corn.

(II) Some corn are rice.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdae9f9964229b8a9d64d5f931d3e5d8e434a42e24da3e53a8be3d925ede0851.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(1) All pulse are corn → **True **(As, All pulse are rice, All rice are wheat, All wheat are corn. so, All pulse are corn holds true)

(II) Some corn are rice → **True **(As, All pulse are rice, All rice are wheat, All wheat are corn. so, Some corn are rice holds true)

Thus, Both conclusions (1) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
